argv: Reject iteration 3: all 1200 frames inspected; mean IoU 0.056 and median 0.0. Rendered 182,192,239,270,299,320,627,1081 show spoon orientation mismatch, large separation, and hallucinated bowl prongs. payload.purpose: Record temporal rejection criterion and proposed stable rotation refinement

argv: Independent mask fits improve projected position and closed-bowl geometry but exhibit ambiguous axial/depth rotation branches: v2 rotation increments reach 21.5 degrees/frame around 652-655 and 717-727, inconsistent with gradual wrist motion. Use continuous quaternion branch and 150ms Gaussian rotational regularization, then refit translation while keeping orientation fixed. Do not accept solely for submillimeter nearest distance.
Prepare v3 candidate and compare full-sequence mask coverage, angular motion and winding penetration against v2; retain only if unstable intervals improve without new silhouette/grasp failures.
Monocular thin-object normal is weakly constrained; temporally independent fitting causes unphysical oscillations despite low silhouette residual.
request.purpose: Record temporal rejection criterion and proposed stable rotation refinement

payload.purpose: Record local contact depth correction hypothesis and falsification checks

argv: At 654 calibrated and side views, thumb/index/middle visibly surround the shaft, so coarse grasp configuration is plausible. Full 1200-frame 128-sample preliminary winding audit finds max estimated finger penetration 17.4mm around 818-829 and p95 6.9mm. Refine only active-hand viewing-ray depth within plus/minus 4cm during 144-1134, regularized over time; retain articulated shape and source pixel placement.
Choose depth offsets that reduce sampled deep penetration while preserving contact, then full-frame winding and RGB/multiview reinspection. Reject if grip leaves shaft or adjacent intervals regress.
This is local depth refinement of a visually plausible grasp, not a substitute for articulation; last out-of-frame right-hand extrapolation stays explicitly uncertain.
request.purpose: Record local contact depth correction hypothesis and falsification checks

payload.purpose: Review repaired full-frame inspection and reject temporal/contact residuals

argv: Iteration 5 repairs global failure: full-frame mean IoU rises from 0.056 to 0.647, median 0.642; closed slotted bowl and shaft now follow RGB. Reviewed montage and calibrated/side frames 250,654,702,793,830,879. Initial drift intervals are resolved in projected location; remaining long low-IoU/rotation intervals 341-381,652-657,691-728,763-796,828-856,875-936,949-1032 require temporal/depth refinement.

All 94 selected numerical intervals reviewed as groups: static/transition short intervals reflect mask edges and minor image shifts; manipulation intervals expose independently fitted 3D rotation jitter, not acceptable despite strong IoU.
Prepared active-hand 128-sample all-frame winding preview finds 17.4mm maximum estimated penetration at 818-829; grip is around correct shaft but depth needs refinement.
Hand temporal regularization reduces right-hand p95 speed 1.36 to 0.62m/s and local deformation 0.179 to 0.108m/s; interpolation at1193-1199 remains disclosed.
Commit stable axis/roll trajectory with special foreshortened-phase handling and smooth hand depth offsets; run final full contact inspection and full-frame silhouette comparison.
request.purpose: Review repaired full-frame inspection and reject temporal/contact residuals

payload.purpose: Record contact refinement regression and corrective branch selection

argv: Final-candidate surface packet exposes penetration around 379 and 652-667: averaging independent positive/negative hand depth optima crossed back through the shaft. Existing sampled options at666 favor +10mm, while Gaussian averaging produced -6.6mm and increased penetration. Replace averaging with temporal dynamic programming over already evaluated options, limit step to20mm/100ms and preserve low-penetration branches.
Reject the averaging artifact, apply DP hand correction after current review completes, and repeat full-frame contact inspection before finalization.
This directly addresses a diagnosed contact regression rather than accepting a favorable nearest-distance score.
request.purpose: Record contact refinement regression and corrective branch selection
